Gigalula for the DMD color setting code

Version 1.1:
- switch GI off during Video Mode
- added DMD color SaddleBrown
- adjusted slingshot rubber height

Version 1.2:
- added Post Diverter at the upper Loop to stop the ball during Ammo Dump Mode (switchable in configuration: ApplyAmmoDumpDiverter)
- DT backdrop image contributed by Batch
- added AutoPlunger light DOF call (script contributed by Sir Cheddar)
  set both Launch Button and Authentic Launch Button in DOF Config Tool to the following:
E170  Blink fu500 fd550
